info.title: Panda Backup API
info.description:
JSON API of Panda Backup.

**Commands.** Requests are routed by a command key in the query string: `GET /api/v1/?archive=5`,
`DELETE /api/v1/?wanted-gallery=3`. If a request has several command keys, the first one in this document's order
wins. `GET /api/v1/` without parameters returns links to this document.

**Authentication.** Anonymous requests can read public data. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (create tokens
on your profile page) or use a session login. Tokens have scopes: `read` for GET, `write` for POST/PUT/DELETE,
`remote` for `/api/v1/remote/`. On `/api/v1/`, a bad or expired token is an error (401) rather than an anonymous
request. Write commands also need the Django permission listed on each operation.

**Errors.** Errors use one envelope, `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`, with a matching HTTP status.

**Background tasks.** Commands that queue worker tasks return `task_id` (or `task_ids`) and a `status_url`;
poll it (`GET ?task=<id>` or `GET ?tasks=<id1>,<id2>`) until `active` is false.

**Legacy routes.** `/api/`, `/api` and `/jsearch/` accept the same commands; their errors also carry the
message in `result`. `/r-api/...` and `/admin-api/` (or `/jsonapi/`) are deprecated: their responses have
`Deprecation` and `Link: rel="successor-version"` headers naming the `/api/v1/` replacement.

get.description:
Status, timestamps (Unix seconds), error message and result summary of a task queued by a write command. Only staff and the user who queued the task can see it.

Token scope: `read`.

post.summary: Run a remote operation (queue links, match archives)
post.description: Needs the `viewer.use_remote_api` permission and, with a token, the `remote` scope. Deprecated aliases: `/admin-api/`, `/jsonapi/`.

args.description: webcrawler: {links, link, downloader, reason, parentLink, action} or a list of links. match_archive: {archive, match_filter}. match_archive_internally: {archive, provider, clear}.

200.description: Operations that queue background tasks (webcrawler, match_archive, match_archive_internally) return task_id and status_url.

get.summary: Gallery search with crawler metadata, including private galleries
get.description: Needs the `viewer.use_remote_api` permission and, with a token, the `remote` scope. Deprecated aliases: `/admin-api/`, `/jsonapi/`.

bearerAuth.description: Long-lived token from the profile page, with read/write/remote scopes.

TaskReference.description: Added to responses of commands that queue background tasks. Commands that queue one task return task_id; commands that may queue several return task_ids. status_url is null when nothing was queued.

result.description: Null while the task is active. outcome, targets (the task's arguments), the deletion options for delete tasks, crawl_stats for crawler tasks and details (what the worker recorded on completion, for the task types that record something).

poll_delay_ms.description: Suggested wait before polling again (0 when done).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed: unknown command, invalid JSON, missing or invalid parameter.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required, or the bearer token is invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: The user lacks the permission, or the token lacks the scope, this command needs.

NotFound.description: The object does not exist, or is not visible to the caller.
